account.cash_claims: Verified dividends/merger entitlements enter NAV; spendability requires separately evidenced availability. No invented cash-in-lieu for fractional split units.
account.end_liquidation: Close remaining executable holdings on Dec29,2023; sale claims after window remain in NAV, unspendable.
account.halt: At observed $2000 decline from running NAV high, permanently halt entries and liquidate at next executable session. Report overshoot and percentage drawdown separately.
account.position_entry_envelope: min($800, 8% of prior complete NAV, settled cash available above the $2000 reserve); retained holdings not routinely resized, so weights can drift.
account.sale_cash_availability: First NYSE session on/after sale date +7 calendar days; conservative research lock, not claimed legal settlement.

adaptation: Long-only small-account adaptation of a published lagged-return formula and buy/hold-spread principle, not an exact replication of either paper. Broad momentum family was previously explored in ETF, crypto and futures experiments.
authorized_by: User approved one $10,000 simulated momentum test, two-hour cap and $0 new paid data.
benchmarks: Constant4%/6% cash reference scenarios over same inclusive dates; not historical rates. Controls assess ranking contribution, not an investment recommendation.
corporate_actions: Reuse qualified cached identity/action adapter, preserve aliases only from evidenced dates. Verified splits adjust held units; fractional results remain unresolved. Held unverified distributions or missing marks block a complete result.
decision: One diagnostic only. Negative or weak after-cost economics, failed risk discipline or unsupported ranking contribution support shelving this version. Positive descriptive evidence can justify separately proposed validation; no automatic promotion, tuning, funding, cohort expansion, new data acquisition or reserved-window test. No sample-size stop replaces calculating what the available data supports.
eligibility: Before monthly entry: 60 prior qualified listed sessions, prior raw close >= $5, median 60-session raw dollar volume >= $2m; full qualified momentum window and one continuous source ticker over it. Missing data/bridge => explicit UNRESOLVED abstention, not certified economically ineligible.
entry_execution: Closing-limit proxy: whole quantity fixed before open from prior raw close and stressed envelope. Fill only when entry close plus stressed 50bp/share costs and fees fits committed budget. No same-day resizing or retry after cancellation.
fees: Reuse archived IBKR Pro Fixed current-rate counterfactual: .005/share, $1 minimum, 1% notional cap; SEC .0000206*sales, TAF .000195*shares sold capped9.79, CAT .000003*shares; each component rounded upward. Actual account tariff and historical fees unverified.
held_unknown: If a held name lacks a valid monthly rank, queue a risk/data exit; source coverage remains flagged. Missing held marks or unresolved actions make complete account performance unresolved; do not backfill or drop the holding.
monthly_rule: First NYSE session: keep existing positions still in retention band and source/price eligible. Sell others at closing proxy; choose highest-ranked entry-band vacancies, up to ten occupied issuer slots. Existing positions scheduled to sell still occupy a slot until sold; no replacement financed by unsettled sale proceeds. Vacancies can refill only at a later monthly review.
name: Liquid individual-stock momentum with a fixed entry/retention buffer
network: Cached market/source data only; official or primary research documentation may be read. No provider requests, keys, account access, orders or purchases.
ranking: Descending fixed momentum score, then SHA256(BA-stock-momentum-buffer-v1|CIK). No positive-score or market trend overlay.
rounding: Ranks 1..N; entry rank <=ceil(.10*N); retention rank <=ceil(.20*N). No parameter sweep.
signal: At prior calendar month-end m, compound monthly total returns for m-11 through m-1, skipping m. For Jan2022 entry: adjusted close Nov30,2021 / adjusted close Dec31,2020 - 1. Require all intervening sessions, no filling missing returns with zero.
uncertainty: Descriptive stationary block bootstrap of paired daily momentum-minus-mean-unranked-account return; 2000 replicates, expected20sessions, seed20260914. Only if all complete. No multiple-search or issuer-cluster correction; already-explored2022-23, never independent validation.
universe: Same fixed 2019 incumbent cohort; all 4800 issuer-month slots retained including dead and missing names. No survivor replacement.
unranked_controls: 20 predeclared independent $10000 virtual baskets (not a pooled $200000 portfolio), same qualified universe, cap, costs, entry/retention bands, cash rules and stop. Replace momentum order with SHA256(BA-stock-unranked-v1|seed|CIK), stable across months; seeds0..19. Report all, their mean account path and dispersion; never select a favorable seed. If any required control account is unresolved, complete mean comparison is unresolved.
